description: American billionaire sports and real estate mogul. Owns Arsenal FC, Los Angeles Rams, Denver Nuggets, Colorado Avalanche, and Colorado Rapids. Founded Kroenke Sports & Entertainment. Also a major real estate developer and Walmart heir (wife Ann Walton).

name: Robert Kraft
title: Owner
description: American billionaire who owns the New England Patriots, New England Revolution, and Gillette Stadium. Also owns Kraft Group with interests in paper, packaging, and real estate. The Patriots won 6 Super Bowls under his ownership.

name: Jerry Jones
title: Owner
description: American billionaire who owns the Dallas Cowboys, the world's most valuable sports franchise. Also owns oil and gas company Jones Oil and Land Lease. Bought the Cowboys for $140M in 1989, now worth $9B+. Known for hands-on management style.

name: Nandan Nilekani
title: Co-Founder
description: Co-founded Infosys. Built Aadhaar, world's largest biometric ID system. Non-Executive Chairman.

name: Armon Dadgar
title: Co-Founder
description: American entrepreneur who co-founded HashiCorp in 2012 with Mitchell Hashimoto. Built infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Vault, Consul) used by most Fortune 500 companies. HashiCorp IPO'd in 2021. Acquired by IBM in 2024 for $6.4B.

name: Noubar Afeyan
title: Founder
description: Armenian-American entrepreneur who co-founded Moderna in 2010. Also founded Flagship Pioneering (2000), a life sciences venture firm that has launched 100+ companies including Moderna. Flagship's portfolio companies have $80B+ aggregate value.

name: Mitchell Hashimoto
title: Founder
description: American software engineer who co-founded HashiCorp in 2012 with Armon Dadgar. Created Vagrant, Terraform, and other infrastructure tools. Left day-to-day role in 2023. HashiCorp acquired by IBM for $6.4B in 2024.

name: Guillermo Rauch
title: Founder
description: Argentine-American entrepreneur who created Next.js and co-founded Vercel in 2015. Previously founded LearnBoost and Cloudup (acquired by Automattic). Vercel powers frontend development for millions of developers. Also created Socket.io.

name: Nithin Kamath
title: Co-Founder & CEO
description: Co-founded Zerodha, India's largest retail stockbroker. Bootstrapped without VC funding.

name: Kunal Shah
title: Founder & CEO
description: Founded CRED rewards platform. Previously sold FreeCharge to Snapdeal. Known for Delta 4 framework.

name: Carlos Slim
title: Chairman
description: Mexican tycoon and former world's richest person. Built a telecom empire through America Movil spanning all of Latin America. Also controls Grupo Carso (industrial conglomerate) and Grupo Financiero Inbursa (financial services). Owns significant stakes in the New York Times and mining companies.

name: Ricardo Salinas
title: Founder
description: Third-generation leader of Grupo Salinas. Built TV Azteca. Major Bitcoin advocate.

name: Michael Siebel
title: Co-Founder
description: American entrepreneur and Y Combinator CEO/partner. Co-founded Justin.tv (2007) which became Twitch. Also co-founded Socialcam (acquired by Autodesk). Became first Black CEO of Y Combinator. Key figure in Silicon Valley startup ecosystem.

name: Cristina Junqueira
title: Co-Founder
description: Brazilian co-founder of Nubank. Head of growth and brand. Former Itau banker.

name: Kevin Lin
title: Co-Founder
description: Co-founded Justin.tv (2007) with Emmett Shear, which pivoted to become Twitch. Served as COO of Twitch until Amazon acquisition for $970M in 2014. Also an early Y Combinator company founder.

name: Henrique Dubugras
title: Co-Founder & CEO
description: Brazilian who co-founded Brex (2017), the corporate card company for startups. Y Combinator success story. Previously co-founded Pagar.me (2013) at age 16, a Brazilian payments company, before moving to Silicon Valley.

name: Pedro Franceschi
title: Co-Founder
description: Brazilian who co-founded Brex with Henrique Dubugras in 2017. Previously co-founded Pagar.me (2013) at age 16, a Brazilian payments processor. Both founders moved from Brazil to Silicon Valley to build Brex.

name: Emmett Shear
title: Co-Founder
description: Co-founded Justin.tv (2007), which pivoted to become Twitch, the dominant live-streaming platform. Sold to Amazon for $970M in 2014. Briefly served as interim OpenAI CEO for 3 days in November 2023. Also co-founded Kiko Calendar, a Y Combinator company.

name: Sam Walton
title: Founder
description: Founded Walmart in 1962. Built it into the world's largest retailer. Died in 1992 when Walmart was worth $58B.

name: Shou Chew
title: CEO
description: Singaporean who became TikTok CEO in 2021. Former CFO of ByteDance. Testified to US Congress.

name: George Lucas
title: Founder
description: Co-founded Tinder, revolutionized dating with swipe interface. Part of Match Group.

name: Cal Henderson
title: Co-Founder & CTO
description: British co-founder and CTO of Slack. Previously built Flickr. Author of 'Building Scalable Web Sites'.

name: Jeffrey Katzenberg
title: Co-Founder
description: Chinese-American who founded Zoom after leaving WebEx. Pandemic made Zoom essential.

name: Tomas Gorny
title: Co-Founder & CEO
description: Polish immigrant who co-founded Nextiva business communications. Previously built IPOWER.

name: Dharmesh Shah
title: Co-Founder & CTO
description: Indian-American who co-founded HubSpot. Created 'inbound marketing' concept. Also creator of ChatSpot AI.

name: Brian Halligan
title: Co-Founder
description: Co-founded HubSpot with Dharmesh Shah. Former CEO until 2024. MIT lecturer.

name: Aneel Bhusri
title: Co-Founder & CEO
description: Co-founded Workday (2005) with Dave Duffield to rebuild enterprise HR software in the cloud. Former PeopleSoft executive. Also a venture partner at Greylock Partners. Stepped down as Workday co-CEO in 2023.

name: Dave Duffield
title: Co-Founder
description: Serial enterprise software pioneer. Founded PeopleSoft in 1987 (acquired by Oracle for $10.3B in 2005), then co-founded Workday in 2005 with Aneel Bhusri to continue the fight. Major philanthropist focused on animal welfare.

name: Benoit Dageville
title: Co-Founder
description: French co-founder of Snowflake. Former Oracle engineer. Built cloud data warehouse architecture.

name: Thierry Breton
title: Former CEO
description: Former Atos and France Telecom CEO. Now EU Commissioner. Former French Finance Minister.

name: Jitse Groen
title: Founder & CEO
description: Dutch who founded Takeaway.com in bedroom. Merged with Just Eat. Sold Grubhub.

name: Marc Samwer
title: Co-Founder
description: German who co-founded Rocket Internet with brothers. Built multiple European unicorns.

name: Richard Kinder
title: Founder
description: Co-founded Kinder Morgan in 1997 with Bill Morgan after buying pipelines from Enron. Built the largest energy infrastructure company in North America. Also served as CEO of Enron before founding KM. Took Kinder Morgan private in 2007, then re-IPO'd in 2011.

name: David Schneider
title: Co-Founder & Co-CEO
description: German who co-founded Zalando with Robert Gentz. Built European fashion e-commerce leader.

name: Kelcy Warren
title: Founder
description: American billionaire who co-founded Energy Transfer Partners, one of the largest natural gas pipeline companies in the US. Built a vast network of pipelines spanning 125,000+ miles across North America. Known for the controversial Dakota Access Pipeline.

name: Anne Boden
title: Founder
description: Welsh who founded Starling Bank digital bank. Stepped down as CEO in 2023.

name: TS Anil
title: CEO
description: Indian-British banker who became Monzo CEO in 2020. Led turnaround to profitability.

name: Yusaku Maezawa
title: Founder
description: Japanese who founded Zozotown fashion e-commerce. Sold to Yahoo Japan. SpaceX lunar trip passenger.

name: Bom Kim
title: Founder & CEO
description: Korean-American who founded Coupang, 'Amazon of South Korea'. Largest Korean IPO on NYSE.

name: Nadiem Makarim
title: Co-Founder
description: Indonesian who founded Gojek super app. Left to become Indonesia's Education Minister.

name: William Tanuwijaya
title: Co-Founder & CEO
description: Indonesian who co-founded Tokopedia e-commerce. Merged with Gojek to form GoTo.

name: Manny Pacquiao
title: Co-Founder
description: Boxing legend who invested in GCASH, Philippines' top fintech. 90M+ users.

name: Eduardo Cojuangco Jr
title: Former Chairman
description: Filipino tycoon who built San Miguel into conglomerate. Passed away in 2020.

name: Ramon Ang
title: CEO
description: Filipino tycoon who transformed San Miguel from beer to infrastructure conglomerate.

name: Peter Reinhardt
title: Founder
description: American entrepreneur who co-founded Segment in 2011, a customer data platform. Sold Segment to Twilio for $3.2B in 2020. Previously a Y Combinator company. Now focuses on climate tech investing.

name: Charoen Sirivadhanabhakdi
title: Chairman
description: Thai who built Thai Beverage and Fraser Property empire. Thailand's second-richest.

name: Brad Keywell
title: Founder
description: American serial entrepreneur based in Chicago. Co-founded Groupon (2008) with Andrew Mason and Eric Lefkofsky. Also founded Uptake Technologies (2014), an industrial AI analytics platform. Previously co-founded MediaOcean and Echo Global Logistics.

name: Gina Rinehart
title: Chairman
description: Australia's richest. Inherited and expanded Hancock Prospecting mining empire. Iron ore focus.

name: Eric Lefkofsky
title: Co-Founder
description: Co-founded Groupon (2008) with Andrew Mason, providing early funding and business strategy. Previously co-founded InnerWorkings and Echo Global Logistics. Serial Chicago entrepreneur. After Groupon, founded Tempus AI (2015), an AI-driven precision medicine company that IPO'd in 2024.

name: James Packer
title: Former Chairman
description: Australian who inherited Crown Resorts. Sold to Blackstone in 2022 after regulatory issues.

name: Kirsty Faulkner
title: CEO
description: Executive at Afterpay. Company sold to Block for $29B in 2022. BNPL pioneer.

name: Andrew Mason
title: Founder & CEO
description: Founded Groupon in 2008, pioneered daily deals. IPO in 2011 at $12.7B, the largest internet IPO since Google at the time. Fired as CEO in 2013. Later founded Descript, an AI-powered audio/video editing tool.

name: Peter Rawlinson
title: CEO
description: British who became Lucid CEO in 2019. Former Tesla Model S chief engineer. Building luxury EVs.

name: RJ Scaringe
title: Founder & CEO
description: Founded Rivian electric truck company. Amazon and Ford invested. Building R1T and R1S.

name: Jim Farley
title: CEO
description: Became Ford CEO in 2020. Leading EV transition with F-150 Lightning and Mustang Mach-E.

name: Mary Barra
title: CEO
description: First female CEO of major automaker (2014). Leading GM's EV transformation with Ultium platform.

name: Herbert Diess
title: Former CEO
description: German who was VW CEO 2018-2022. Led EV pivot after dieselgate. Left over software issues.

name: Lachlan Murdoch
title: CEO
description: Australian-American media executive, son of Rupert Murdoch. Executive Chairman of News Corp and Fox Corporation. Took over leadership of family media empire. Also chairs NOVA Entertainment in Australia.

milestones.event: Became sole successor to Murdoch empire

name: Cher Wang
title: Co-Founder
description: Taiwanese businesswoman who co-founded HTC in 1997 with Cher Mi Wang and Peter Chou. Daughter of Wang Yung-ching (Formosa Plastics founder). HTC was once the world's largest smartphone maker by market cap. Also chairs XRSPACE, a VR company.

name: John de Mol
title: Founder
description: Dutch media mogul who co-founded Endemol in 1994, creator of Big Brother and Deal or No Deal reality TV formats. Sold Endemol to Telefonica. Also founded Talpa Network/Media, which later merged with RTL to form Europe's largest entertainment company.

name: Qasar Younis
title: Founder
description: South Africa's first Black billionaire. Founded ARM mining. Also owns Mamelodi Sundowns FC.

name: Arnout Schuijff
title: Co-Founder
description: Dutch co-founder and CTO of Adyen, a global payments platform processing billions in transactions. Built Adyen's technology from scratch. Previously worked at Bibit, which was acquired by Royal Bank of Scotland. Adyen IPO'd in Amsterdam in 2018.

name: Pieter van der Does
title: Co-Founder
description: Egyptian billionaire who leads OCI fertilizers. Also owns stake in Adidas and Aston Villa FC.

name: Markus Villig
title: Founder
description: Egyptian telecom tycoon. Brother of Nassef. Built and sold Wind Telecom. Owns Euronews.

name: Abdul Latif Jameel
title: Chairman
description: Saudi family business. Toyota distributor for Middle East. Expanding into renewable energy.

name: Majid Al Futtaim
title: Founder
description: Emirati who founded MAF Group. Operates Carrefour in Middle East. Mall of the Emirates owner.

name: Tony Elumelu
title: Chairman
description: Nigerian banker and philanthropist. Transformed UBA into pan-African bank. Africapitalism advocate.

name: Martin Villig
title: Co-Founder
description: Estonian co-founder of Bolt (formerly Taxify) in 2013 with Markus Villig. Built Bolt into Europe's leading ride-hailing and mobility platform operating across 45+ countries. Previously worked in consulting.

name: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
title: Founder & Chairperson
description: Indian who founded Biocon, Asia's largest biopharmaceuticals company. Self-made billionaire.

name: Adar Poonawalla
title: CEO
description: Son of Cyrus Poonawalla. Leads Serum Institute operations. Key in global vaccine supply.

name: Priit Kasesalu
title: Co-Founder
description: Estonian programmer who was one of the original developers of Skype in 2003. Part of the Estonian tech team (with Ahti Heinla and Jaan Tallinn) that built Skype's peer-to-peer architecture. Skype sold to eBay for $2.6B, then to Microsoft for $8.5B.

name: Ahti Heinla
title: Co-Founder
description: Estonian programmer who co-developed Skype in 2003 with Priit Kasesalu and Jaan Tallinn. Built the peer-to-peer VoIP technology. Previously worked on Kazaa. After Skype, became CTO at Starship Technologies, building autonomous delivery robots.

name: Kumar Mangalam Birla
title: Chairman
description: Indian who chairs Aditya Birla Group. Owns Vodafone Idea, UltraTech Cement, Grasim.

name: Jaan Tallinn
title: Co-Founder
description: Estonian programmer who co-developed Skype and Kazaa. Co-founded the Centre for the Study of Existential Risk and the Future of Life Institute, focused on AI safety. Major philanthropist funding existential risk research. One of Estonia's wealthiest people.

milestones.event: Co-founded CSER and FLI for AI safety

name: Victor Jacobsson
title: Co-Founder
description: Hong Kong's richest until recently. Built CK Hutchison empire. Known as 'Superman Li'.

name: Henry Cheng
title: Chairman
description: Hong Kong tycoon. Chairs Chow Tai Fook jewelry and New World Development property.

name: Fredrik Ljungstrom
title: Co-Founder
description: Swedish co-founder of Klarna with Sebastian Siemiatkowski and Victor Jacobsson. Helped build Klarna into one of Europe's most valuable fintech companies, pioneering buy-now-pay-later payments.

name: Quek Leng Chan
title: Chairman
description: Malaysian who chairs Hong Leong Group. Banking, property, manufacturing conglomerate.

name: Ananda Krishnan
title: Founder
description: Malaysian who founded Maxis telecom. Reclusive billionaire. Also owns Astro media.

name: Tony Fernandes
title: Founder & CEO
description: Malaysian who bought struggling AirAsia for $0.25. Built into Asia's largest low-cost carrier.

name: Chairul Tanjung
title: Founder
description: Indonesian who built CT Corp from scratch. Owns Trans Media, Bank Mega, Trans Retail.

name: John Gokongwei Jr
title: Founder
description: Filipino who built JG Summit conglomerate. Owns Cebu Pacific, Robinsons, Universal Robina.

name: Lucio Tan
title: Chairman
description: Filipino-Chinese who built LT Group. Owns PAL Airlines, Fortune Tobacco, PNB.

name: Enrique Razon Jr
title: Chairman
description: Filipino who built ICTSI, world's largest independent port operator. Also owns Solaire casino.

name: Sheldon Adelson
title: Founder
description: American who founded Las Vegas Sands and Venetian casino empire. Passed away in 2021.

name: Miriam Adelson
title: Majority Owner
description: Israeli-American physician, widow of Sheldon Adelson. Now majority owner of Las Vegas Sands.

name: Steve Wynn
title: Founder
description: American casino mogul who founded Wynn Resorts. Left company in 2018 amid misconduct allegations.

name: Stanley Ho
title: Founder
description: Macau gambling king who monopolized casino industry for 40 years. Passed away in 2020.

name: Lawrence Ho
title: Chairman & CEO
description: Son of Stanley Ho. Built Melco Resorts competing with father's empire. City of Dreams operator.

name: Xu Jiayin
title: Founder
description: Chinese who founded Evergrande. Once China's richest, now mired in $300B debt crisis.

name: Yang Huiyan
title: Co-Chairman
description: Chinese who inherited Country Garden from father. Once China's richest woman, now in debt crisis.

name: Shin Dong-bin
title: Chairman
description: Korean-Japanese businessman who chairs Lotte Group, a major South Korean conglomerate spanning retail, food, hotels, chemicals, and entertainment. Son of Lotte founder Shin Kyuk-ho. Won control of group in 2015 family feud. Convicted of bribery in 2018 but pardoned.

name: Zeng Yuqun
title: Founder & Chairman
description: Chinese who founded CATL, world's largest EV battery maker. Supplies Tesla, BMW, others.

name: Zhong Shanshan
title: Founder
description: China's richest. Founded Nongfu Spring bottled water and Beijing Wantai pharmaceutical.

name: James Ratcliffe
title: Founder & Chairman
description: British who founded INEOS chemicals. UK's richest. Now owns stake in Manchester United.

name: Goh Cheng Liang
title: Founder
description: Singaporean who founded Wuthelam. Largest shareholder in Nippon Paint. Singapore's richest.

name: Zhang Shiping
title: Founder
description: Chinese who founded China Hongqiao, world's largest aluminum producer. Passed away in 2019.

name: Kim Bom-jun
title: Founder
description: Austrian who co-founded Red Bull energy drink. Created entire energy drink category. Passed away 2022.

name: Chaleo Yoovidhya
title: Co-Founder
description: Thai who created Krating Daeng and co-founded Red Bull. Passed away 2012. Family remains owners.

name: Chung Euisun
title: Chairman
description: Executive Chairman of Hyundai Motor Group, South Korea's largest automaker. Grandson of Hyundai founder Chung Ju-yung. Expanded into luxury (Genesis) and electric vehicles. Leading Hyundai-Kia's push into EVs, robotics, and urban air mobility with Supernal.

name: Takeshi Uchiyamada
title: Chairman
description: Japanese engineer who chaired Toyota Motor Corporation. Known as the 'father of the Prius' for leading development of the first mass-produced hybrid car. Served as Toyota chairman from 2013. Instrumental in Toyota's hybrid and hydrogen fuel cell strategy.

name: Francois Pinault
title: Founder
description: French who founded Pinault Group (now Kering). Major art collector. Christie's owner.

name: Alain Wertheimer
title: Co-Owner
description: French who co-owns Chanel with brother. Grandsons of original partner. Notoriously private.

name: Gerard Wertheimer
title: Co-Owner
description: French who co-owns Chanel with brother Alain. Also owns thoroughbred horse racing operations.

name: Matsushita Konosuke
title: Founder
description: Japanese industrialist who founded Panasonic (originally Matsushita Electric) in 1918. Built it into one of Japan's largest electronics conglomerates. Pioneer of Japanese manufacturing excellence and management philosophy. Passed away in 1989.

name: Toyoda Kiichiro
title: Founder
description: Japanese industrialist who founded Toyota Motor Corporation in 1937. Son of Toyoda Sakichi (inventor of automatic loom). Pioneered Japan's automotive industry. His vision of mass-producing cars transformed Japan into a global auto manufacturing leader. Passed away in 1952.

name: Honda Soichiro
title: Founder
description: Japanese engineer and industrialist who founded Honda Motor Company in 1948. Started with motorized bicycles, grew into one of the world's largest automakers and engine manufacturers. Pioneer of Japanese automotive industry. Passed away in 1991.

name: Takeo Shiina
title: Former CEO
description: Japanese businessman who led IBM Japan as president and chairman. Instrumental in expanding IBM's presence in the Japanese market. One of the most influential foreign technology executives in Japan.

milestones.event: Rose to leadership at IBM Japan

name: Karl Albrecht Jr
title: Co-Owner
description: German heir to Aldi Sud discount retailer. Family fortune from discount grocery revolution.

name: Theo Albrecht Jr
title: Co-Owner
description: German heir to Aldi Nord and Trader Joe's. Part of Albrecht discount grocery dynasty.

name: Kazuo Inamori
title: Founder
description: Japanese entrepreneur who founded Kyocera (1959) and KDDI (2000, now Japan's second-largest telecom). Also rescued Japan Airlines from bankruptcy in 2010. Founded Inamori Foundation. Known for his management philosophy 'Amoeba Management.' Passed away in 2022.

name: Jorge Moll Filho
title: Co-Founder
description: Brazilian who co-founded Rede D'Or, Latin America's largest hospital network.

name: Zong Qinghou
title: Founder
description: Chinese entrepreneur who founded Wahaha Group in 1987, China's largest beverage company. Known for its bottled water and juice drinks. Built Wahaha into a household brand across China with $10B+ annual revenue. Passed away in 2024.

name: Zhang Xin
title: Co-Founder
description: American who founded Shift4 payments at 16. Flew on SpaceX Inspiration4. Space tourism pioneer.

name: Robert Pera
title: Founder & CEO
description: American who founded Ubiquiti networking. Owns Memphis Grizzlies NBA team.

name: Pan Shiyi
title: Co-Founder
description: American who founded Luminar lidar at 17. Youngest self-made billionaire at IPO. Thiel Fellow.

name: Liu Yongxing
title: Founder
description: Chinese billionaire who co-founded East Hope Group with brothers. Built major aluminum and chemical manufacturing empire. Also heavily invested in agriculture and animal feed across China.

milestones.event: Split to form East Hope Group

name: Liu Yonghao
title: Founder
description: Chinese billionaire who co-founded Hope Group with brothers. Later founded New Hope Group, one of China's largest agribusiness and animal feed companies. Also expanded into dairy, real estate, and financial services.

name: Lu Weiding
title: Chairman
description: Son of Lu Guanqiu. Inherited leadership of Wanxiang Group, China's largest auto parts manufacturer. Expanded into electric vehicles, clean energy, and financial services. Wanxiang America acquired A123 Systems and Fisker Automotive assets.

name: Lu Guanqiu
title: Founder
description: Chinese entrepreneur who founded Wanxiang Group in 1969 as a bicycle repair shop, building it into China's largest auto parts manufacturer. Supplied major global automakers. Pioneered Chinese private enterprise. Passed away in 2017.

milestones.event: Founded Wanxiang as bicycle repair shop

name: Sun Piaoyang
title: Founder
description: Chinese pharmaceutical billionaire. Built Hengrui Medicine into China's largest pharmaceutical company by market cap. Known as 'China's pharma king.' Focus on oncology, anesthesia, and contrast agents. Also expanding into innovative biologics.

milestones.event: Became China's largest pharma by market cap

name: Chen Rui
title: Chairman
description: Chinese entrepreneur who co-founded Bilibili, China's leading anime and gaming video platform. Grew it into a major cultural hub for young Chinese users with 300M+ monthly active users.

name: Enrique Lores
title: CEO
description: Became HP Inc CEO in 2019. Manages HP's PC and printing business after the Hewlett-Packard split.

name: Antonio Neri
title: CEO
description: Became HPE CEO in 2018. Leads Hewlett Packard Enterprise's hybrid cloud and edge computing strategy.

name: Felix Dennis
title: Founder
description: British who founded Dennis Publishing. Created Maxim, The Week. Passed away 2014. Poet.

name: Jay-Z
title: Founder
description: American rapper who built business empire. Roc Nation, Armand de Brignac, D'Usse. Hip-hop's first billionaire.

name: Dr. Dre
title: Co-Founder
description: American rapper/producer who co-founded Beats headphones. Sold to Apple for $3B in 2014.

name: Jimmy Iovine
title: Co-Founder
description: American music producer who co-founded Beats Electronics (2006) with Dr. Dre. Beats was sold to Apple for $3B in 2014, the largest acquisition in Apple's history. Also founded Interscope Records and produced music for Eminem, Lady Gaga, U2, and others.

name: Kim Kardashian
title: Founder
description: American who founded SKIMS shapewear. Valued at $4B. NFL partnership announced 2024.

name: Martha Stewart
title: Founder
description: American who built lifestyle empire. Overcame prison for insider trading. Brand endures.

name: Tory Burch
title: Founder & CEO
description: American who founded eponymous fashion brand. Known for Reva flats and double-T logo.

name: Michael Kors
title: Founder
description: American designer who founded eponymous brand. Capri Holdings owns Versace, Jimmy Choo.

name: Patrizio Bertelli
title: Co-CEO
description: Italian who runs Prada business with wife Miuccia. Built manufacturing excellence.

name: John Elkann
title: Chairman
description: Italian heir to Agnelli family. Chairs Exor holding (Ferrari, Stellantis, Juventus, The Economist).

name: Carlos Tavares
title: CEO
description: Portuguese who leads Stellantis (Chrysler, Jeep, Peugeot, Fiat). Created from PSA-FCA merger.

name: Oliver Blume
title: CEO
description: Became VW Group CEO in 2022 while also leading Porsche AG. Managing Volkswagen's challenging EV transition across 10 brands including VW, Audi, Porsche, Lamborghini, and Bentley. Previously led Porsche to record profitability.

name: Ola Kaellenius
title: CEO
description: Swedish-born executive who became Mercedes-Benz CEO in 2019. First non-German CEO in the company's history. Previously led Mercedes-AMG. Focusing Mercedes on electric and luxury vehicles. Managing the transition from combustion engines to EVs.

name: Oliver Zipse
title: CEO
description: German who leads BMW. Managing EV and combustion balance. Strong China business.

name: Ferdinand Piech
title: Former Chairman
description: Austrian engineer who transformed VW. Porsche heir. Created W12 engine. Passed away 2019.

name: Wolfgang Porsche
title: Chairman
description: German who chairs Porsche SE holding. Son of Ferry Porsche. Controls VW and Porsche.

name: Luca de Meo
title: CEO
description: Italian who leads Renault. Former Seat CEO. Restructured Renault post-Nissan drama.

name: Carlos Ghosn
title: Former CEO
description: Brazilian-French-Lebanese who saved Nissan. Fled Japan in musical instrument case in 2019 after arrest.

name: Akio Toyoda
title: Chairman
description: Japanese who leads Toyota. Grandson of founder. Stepped back as CEO in 2023 but remains Chairman.

name: Koji Sato
title: CEO
description: Japanese who became Toyota CEO in 2023. Former Lexus head. Leading EV acceleration.

name: Toshihiro Mibe
title: CEO
description: Japanese who leads Honda. Former R&D head. Announced Nissan merger talks in 2024.

name: Osamu Suzuki
title: Former Chairman
description: Japanese who led Suzuki for 40 years. Married into founder family. Stepped down at 91 in 2021.

name: Kenichiro Yoshida
title: CEO
description: Japanese who leads Sony. Transformed focus to entertainment, gaming, sensors. PS5 success.

name: Kazuo Hirai
title: Former CEO
description: Japanese who saved Sony 2012-2018. Focused on gaming and entertainment. Now board member.

name: Masahiro Miki
title: Founder & CEO
description: Japanese who built Workman workwear chain. Pivoted to casual wear. Japan's fastest-growing retailer.

name: Jim Whitehurst
title: Former CEO
description: Became Red Hat CEO in 2007. Grew the open-source company from $4B to $34B before IBM acquisition in 2019.

name: Cathie Wood
title: Founder & CEO
description: American who founded ARK Invest. Disruptive innovation focus. Tesla bull. $50B+ AUM at peak.

name: Safra Catz
title: CEO
description: Became Oracle co-CEO in 2014, sole CEO in 2019. Led Oracle's cloud transformation and AI strategy.

name: Mike Cagney
title: Founder & CEO
description: Serial fintech founder. Co-founded SoFi in 2011 (departed 2017 at $4.3B valuation, creating $3.8B for others). Founded Figure Technologies in 2018, pioneering blockchain-based lending. Figure IPO'd Sept 2025 at $5.3B, now worth $14B.
